name: hotslot
description: Find the storage slots and shared balances that stop Monad from running your transactions in parallel

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/hotslot.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire as __hotslotRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __hotslotRequire(import.meta.url);"
